title: A Protocol for the Vector
author: Beatrix Pemberton
blurb: Marguerite Dravenmoor, the caretaker of Earth's abandoned seed vault, has spent fifteen years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
